source_evidence: For accepted orders the warehouse picks the parts, packs the order and books a carrier.
problem: The warehouse department is classified as an automated system rather than a human department.
correction: Change Lane_warehouse laneMeta authority from "authority" to "sovereignty".

source_evidence:
The warehouse also does quality inspection and labelling for each order, but nobody could
say whether those happen before or after packing, or in which order relative to each other.

map_evidence.quote: <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="pick-parts--quality-inspection" sourceRef="pick-parts" targetRef="quality-inspection" /><bpmn:sequenceFlow id="quality-inspection--pack-order" sourceRef="quality-inspection" targetRef="pack-order" />

problem: The map fixes quality inspection between picking and packing despite the source explicitly leaving its order unknown.
correction: Remove pick-parts--quality-inspection and quality-inspection--pack-order and their incoming/outgoing references, restore a direct pick-parts--pack-order flow, and leave quality-inspection unconnected with an associated note declaring its unknown order relative to packing and labelling.

map_evidence.quote: <bpmn:task id="send-payment-reminder" name="Send payment reminder"><bpmn:documentation>source: "The ERP sends a payment reminder after seven days."</bpmn:documentation>

problem: The map adds an unsupported ERP payment-reminder step after invoicing and attributes a fabricated seven-day reminder quotation to the source.
correction: Remove send-payment-reminder, its lane reference, and its incident flows and incoming/outgoing references; connect generate-and-send-invoice directly to accepted-order-fulfilled.
